responsibility: Declares the Rust HIR pattern-analysis subsystem for match checking. It exposes the crate visitor PatternChecker and the check_match_usefulness entry point, and defines the constructor/pattern/matrix/witness data structures—such as Constructor, DeconstructedPat, PatOrWild, MatrixRow, PlaceInfo, Matrix, MatchArm, WitnessPat, and WitnessMatrix—that model lowered match patterns and support recursive exhaustiveness/usefulness analysis over typed scrutinee structure.
same_name_distinction: Within the rust-hir-pattern-analysis pair, this .h file is the declarative interface and type-definition side, exposing PatternChecker, check_match_usefulness, and the constructor/matrix/witness classes, while the companion .cc file provides their operational algorithms and traversal logic.
